verdict.rationale: Stripe documents registering smart readers to an account by registration code, serial number, or order number. The serial-number method works right after unboxing without physical access, and readers are registered to a location before accepting payments (docs-5, docs-20, docs-13). Readers can also be ordered, registered, configured and monitored from the Dashboard, and payments can be taken through a no-code option or Tap to Pay on iPhone via the Dashboard mobile app (docs-32, docs-26, docs-21, docs-50, docs-2). missing for 10: a documented step-by-step flow for pairing a Bluetooth reader with a POS app, and independent or hands-on evidence that first payment really happens within minutes.
